racers.name: Nau
racers.bio:
Nobody knows where you ride out of and nobody has asked twice.
You get the last slot on the grid because you have not earned another.

racers.name: Farida Qasim
racers.bio:
Six years a night courier before anyone put money on her.
She does not race the road, she races the map, and the map does not change.

racers.name: Ishaan Marwah
racers.bio:
His father buys the bike, the fuel, and the silence afterwards.
Too much machine and not enough road under him, and everyone can see it but him.

racers.name: Pritam Sodhi
racers.bio:
Keeps a workshop off the bypass and half the grid owes him for it.
He has never swung first at anybody. He has also never forgotten anybody.

racers.name: Meher Jaggi
racers.bio:
Came up through the flyover crowd, where the only line is the fastest one.
Will take a gap that is not there and dare the other rider to close it.

racers.name: Rustam Bedi
racers.bio:
Drives a tempo by day, which is why nothing in traffic surprises him.
He is not the quickest out here and he finishes more races than most who are.

racers.name: Asma Vohra
racers.bio:
Rode her brother's bike for two years before he found out.
She races like someone who expects to have to explain herself later and would rather win first.

racers.name: Dev Tandon
racers.bio:
Sits third for eleven kilometres and takes second in the last two.
Patience is the whole of his game and it works more often than it should.

racers.name: Kabir Anand
racers.bio:
Starts the fight, wins the fight, loses the race, comes back next week.
He has been asked to stop and it has never once landed.

racers.name: Noor Siddiqui
racers.bio:
Reads a road the way she reads a room, which is to say completely and without comment.
The only rider on the grid who has never been caught by the police.

racers.name: Hemant Rele
racers.bio:
Lost a bike to a barricade on the flyway and has raced angry ever since.
Quick enough to be a problem, sore enough to be a reliable one.

racers.name: Sabina Thapa
racers.bio:
Two seasons unbeaten on the Ridge before anyone learned her name.
She rides like the road is a thing she has already been told the answer to.

racers.name: Vikram Lall
racers.bio:
Middling at everything, which on this grid is a kind of achievement.
He will be behind you all race and in front of you at the line if you make one mistake.

racers.name: Zoya Mirchandani
racers.bio:
Runs the book on half these races and rides in them anyway.
Being owed money by everyone on the grid has not made her gentle with any of them.
